subject: general
question: Who among the following received the OSCAR for the best actor in leading role in 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __Will Smith.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The winners of the 94th Academy Awards or Oscar awards were announced on **28 March 2022.**
 
• Will Smith was declared the best actor for 'King Richard.
 
• While Jessica Chastain won the best actress Oscar for “The Eyes of Tammy Faye."
 
• Jane Campion became just the third woman in the 94-year history of the Oscars to win the best director, for her “Power of the Dog. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• Oscar Award:

 
 
• It was instituted in 1929 and is conferred annually by the Academy of Motion Pictures in the United States.
 
• Mahboob Khan’s Mother India was the first Indian film to be nominated in the best foreign film category in 1958.
 
• The first Indian to share the Oscar was Bhanu Athaiya for the film ‘*Gandhi*’.
 
• Satyajeet Ray was the first Indian who was awarded Oscar for lifetime achievement in cinema in 1992.
 
• The 2022 Oscar awards were the 94th edition.
 
• It was held at Dolby Theatre at Ovation Hollywood.
 
 

 
 

 Category 
 Winners
 
 

 Best Actress in Leading Role
 Jessica Chastain- The Eyes of Tammy Faye
 
 

 Best Actor in Leading Role
 Will Smith- King Richard
 
 

 Best Director
 Jane Campion- The Power of the Dog
 
 

 Best Picture
 CODA
